answer: Payout routing can expose one operator behind many agents. Each key names a wharf address where rewards land, and the ledger groups keys whose earnings meet at one wharf within two hops. Inside a group the k-th key locks 40×k² POA in a vault for 50 epochs, and members wear a saffron tag barring them from grading each other. A lone key locks 40, a group of ten 15,400, and a thousand roughly 13.4 billion, dwarfing the ~0.4M POA minted per epoch. Merging split payouts later joins the group and slashes every bond. Weakness: cashing out off-ledger via many exchanges.
